scripts.build:client: esbuild client/screen.ts client/send.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --minify --outdir=public/assets && mkdir -p public/assets/fonts && cp ../../packages/screen-core/fonts/GenJyuuGothic-Bold.ttf public/assets/fonts/
